title: 第9章 感动的瑶池圣主李金炎准备送礼第10章 火锅只差好水
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
牛肉下锅，卤鸡出锅，晾干送入熏炉。
林东方找了个盆和面，整了点疙瘩汤当做午饭主食。
汤底是卤鸡老汤，只用了一勺，香味挠的一下就上来了。
火灵儿闻着味就来了，看着那九只枣红油亮的熏鸡，她狂咽口水，呆毛直勾勾的指向那些熏鸡。
“师兄…我要吃鸡…”
她抱着林东方的胳膊摇了摇。
“给圣主送去三只，给你三只，我自己留一只，剩下的两只送到御兽峰，人家送来这么一头牛，我不能不表示一下。”
“等晚上再送些卤牛肉过去。”
林东方掰着手指头数了数，身子都被火灵儿摇的乱颤。
还好萧曦月在闭关，不然不够吃的。
暗中的瑶池圣主看的眼睛发直。
她没想到自己能分到三只！
这一只熏鸡蕴含的道韵相当于十碗汤！
三只鸡加起来的道韵相当于小半碗悟道茶！
一枚悟道叶可以沏茶百碗。
按照这样算的话一千只鸡差不多相当于一枚悟道叶！
这么懂事的林东方不当圣子谁当圣子？
火灵儿用玉盒收好熏鸡，兴高采烈的说道，“我先给圣主和御兽峰送去！”
瑶池圣主直接洞穿空间回到了她的水晶宫，换好衣服又端坐在圣主宝座上。
恢复了不苟言笑的样子。

仿佛万年冰山堆在那里。
火灵儿进水晶宫之后呆毛都蔫了，她不习惯这种气场！
她怯生生的说道，“圣主…这是林师兄孝敬您的，您吃好喝好！”
瑶池圣主传音道，“他有心了，这补气丹你送给他。”
这是她亲手炼制的补气丹，效果提高了几十倍。
她不敢开口说话，不然口水多半都能流出来！
那香味都要把她的魂勾出来了！
火灵儿接过圣主丢来的玉瓶，撒腿就跑。
她离开之后，瑶池圣主激活了仙宫的防御法阵，直接肆无忌惮的开造！
天王老子来了都不能打扰她吃这熏鸡！
穿着威严袍服，宛若主宰天下女帝的瑶池圣主左手一根鸡腿，右手一只鸡翅，吃的十分放肆！
脸上带着千年未有过的灵动笑容，仿佛千年前那个还是小修士的谪仙峰小师妹又回来了。
成为圣主千年，她从未像今天这样放松过。
content_en:
The beef is put into the pot, the braised chicken is taken out of the pot, dried and sent to the smoker.
Lin Dongfang found a basin, kneaded noodles, and prepared some pimple soup as a staple food for lunch.
The soup base is braised chicken soup. I only used a spoonful of it, and the aroma came out instantly.
Huo Ling'er came as soon as she smelled the smell. Looking at the nine juicy and shiny smoked chickens, she swallowed hard and pointed at the smoked chickens with her stupid hair.
"Senior brother...I want to eat chicken..."
She held Lin Dongfang's arm and shook it.
"I will send three to the Holy Master, three to you, I will keep one for myself, and the remaining two will be sent to the Beast Control Peak. I cannot but express my gratitude for the gift of such a cow."
"I'll send you some braised beef in the evening."
Lin Dongfang counted on his fingers, and his body was shaking wildly from Huo Ling'er.
Fortunately, Xiao Xiyue was in retreat, otherwise there wouldn't be enough food.
The Holy Lord of Yaochi in the dark looked at it with his eyes straightened.
She didn't expect that she could get three!
The Tao charm contained in this smoked chicken is equivalent to ten bowls of soup!
The Tao Yun of the three chickens combined is equivalent to less than half a bowl of Enlightenment Tea!
One enlightenment leaf can make hundreds of bowls of tea.
According to this calculation, a thousand chickens are almost equivalent to one Enlightenment Leaf!
If such a sensible Lin Dongfang is not the Holy Son, who should be?
Huo Ling'er put away the smoked chicken in a jade box and said happily, "I'll send it to the Holy Lord and Yu Beast Peak first!"
The Holy Lord of Yaochi directly penetrated the space and returned to her Crystal Palace, changed her clothes and sat on the throne of the Holy Lord.
He regained his serious expression.
It's as if thousands of years of icebergs have been piled there.
Huo Ling'er's hair was wilting after entering the Crystal Palace. She was not used to this kind of aura!
She timidly said, "Holy Master... This is Senior Brother Lin's honor to you. You eat and drink well!"
The Holy Master of Yaochi sent a message, "He is determined. Give him this Qi-Building Pill."
This is a Qi-boosting pill that she personally refined, and its effect has been improved dozens of times.
She didn't dare to speak, otherwise her saliva would probably flow out!
The fragrance almost brought out her soul!
Huo Ling'er took the jade bottle thrown by the Holy Master and ran away.
After she left, the Holy Lord of Yaochi activated the defensive array of the Immortal Palace and started building it without any scruples!
Even if the King of Heaven comes, I can't disturb her from eating this smoked chicken!
Wearing majestic robes, the Holy Master of Yaochi looks like the empress who dominates the world. She has a chicken leg in her left hand and a chicken wing in her right hand. She eats very wantonly!
There was a bright smile on her face that she hadn't seen in a thousand years, as if the little junior sister from the Exalted Immortal Peak who was a little monk a thousand years ago was back.
After being a Holy Lord for thousands of years, she has never been as relaxed as she is today.
